command:
set -euo pipefail
D=$HOME/.local/state/omega-grid-relay
F=$D/omega_grid_relay_main.py
mkdir -p "$D"
[ ! -e "$F" ] || { echo CANDIDATE_EXISTS; sha256sum "$F"; exit 42; }
gh api 'repos/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity/contents/tools/omega_grid_relay.py?ref=main' --jq .content | tr -d '\n' | base64 -d > "$F"
python3 -m py_compile "$F"
echo CANDIDATE_SHA=$(sha256sum "$F" | awk '{print $1}')
